metadata.title: Exploring INDIA'S Evolving Foodscape with Charmaine O'Brien & Anubhav Sapra I Changing Food Trends
metadata.description:
Few days back we had the opportunity to host internationally acclaimed Australian food writer Charmaine O’Brien for a food walk that revolves around the premise of her latest book ' Eating the Present, Tasting the Future ' . It was an ecstatic and memorable experience for us since she is one of Anubahv's favourite food writers whose work continues to be a huge influence in his pursuits. 

Charmaine has been researching and writing on Indian and Australian culinary history and culture for more than two decades. Her extensive journey across the length and breadth of India has resulted in a deeper knowledge of the Indian culinary traditions from the inside out. 

In her latest book, she unravels the multiple facets of India's contemporary foodscape and the forces transforming it. At a time when culinary cultures are topics of increasing global interest, the book offers a unique insight into the evolution of the complex food scene of India. 

Come along with us on this cherished and enriching experience.

To order your copy of the book, visit the link -https://amzn.to/3VqgHpP

We extend our sincere thanks to The Australian High Commission, New Delhi for giving us this opportunity.
